title: the pages of ObjectFFRF and ObjectFFRFreducedOrder link example pages that the PDF leaves out
author: Claude-JG
description: The descriptions of ObjectFFRF and ObjectFFRFreducedOrder (#2734/#2735) link [](#examples-ngsolveffrf), [](#examples-ngsolvecmstutorial) and [](#testmodels-objectffrfreducedordertest). The PDF build excludes the example and test model pages (conf.py), so the three links are unresolved there (myst.xref_missing). An item page names its examples through the examples field, which the page lists with github links; checkDefinitions shall reject a link to an example page.
releaseNotes: The pages of ObjectFFRF and ObjectFFRFreducedOrder name their complete models (NGsolveFFRF.py, NGsolveCMStutorial.py, objectFFRFreducedOrderTest.py) and list them with their github links; the PDF documentation no longer reports unresolved references on them.
